entities.summary: Sergei Afanasyevich Kolosov is a Belarusian former ice hockey defenceman. He last played with Generals Kyiv of the Ukrainian Hockey League. Kolosov was drafted by the Detroit Red Wings of the National Hockey League (NHL) in 2004, and signed a contract with the team on June 25, 2008.
